
### Cryptotrends VIP — Daily Crypto Analysis & Charts

**Cryptotrends VIP** is a modern, SEO-optimized landing page that displays automatically updated cryptocurrency analyses and candlestick charts generated by the [Crypto Trend Analysis](https://github.com/FreakyLime/crypto-trend-analysis) engine.

Built with **Tailwind CSS** and  **Supabase** , it provides a fast, responsive interface where users can explore fresh insights, search by symbol, and view detailed chart snapshots — all in one place.

Receive instant updates about new analyses through our Telegram bot → [@Alerts_123bot]().

**Features**

* Daily refreshed crypto analyses and charts
* SEO-optimized metadata and JSON-LD for better visibility
* Clean, responsive design for desktop and mobile
* Instant Telegram alerts for new insights
* Easy deployment on GitHub Pages or any static host
